resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1935 log cabin and the 1955 41-foot tower were earlier structures. The 1973 date is the current R-6 cab and tower.

notes_for_editor: Elevation conflict is unresolved: the register gives 5,548 ft (1,691 m), while firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts give 5,709 ft (about 1,740 m). The record keeps the register value. The 41-ft height is from the register and the 1959 survey note; the height to the cab floor is not stated. No source read says whether the public may visit, so access is left unknown. Staffing as_of is omitted because the sources give no date beyond the 1980s and the 2020 register text. No new photos. The distance from Canyon Ranger Station is cited to firelookout.com only; the register does not give it.
